description:
Singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. talks about how a Pixies' song showed up in "Hardwired"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Stephen Wilson Jr’s latest song, “Hardwired,” certainly draws from Wilson Jr’s country influences, but it also contains a hallmark of his rock and grunge inspirations — in particular, a song by Boston band Pixies. “For some reason, ‘Where Is My Mind’ just kept showing up in my head,” Wilson Jr. explains, thinking back on the songwriting session. As it happened, the song by Pixies’ landed well in the song as Wilson Jr., Miranda Lambert and others were working on it. Hear Wilson Jr. Tell the story above.

Stephen Wilson Jr. was Zach McCormick's guest on The Current's July 31, 2026, episode of Tonal Recall, the show that celebrates the music and culture of the 1990s. Find the full interview with Stephen Wilson Jr. here: https://youtu.be/5VhaMOoMaDs
